description: This source file implements the HostResolverSystemTask class and related functions for DNS resolution management within the Chromium net namespace, including task scheduling, DNS resolution, and logging.

classes.name: HostResolverSystemTask
classes.description: Manages DNS resolution attempts with retries, logging, and support for override hooks.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::Create
methods.description: Creates a new HostResolverSystemTask for a specific hostname.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::CreateForOwnHostname
methods.description: Creates a new HostResolverSystemTask for resolving the local hostname.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::Start
methods.description: Begins the DNS resolution process with a callback for results.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::StartLookupAttempt
methods.description: Initiates a DNS lookup attempt, possibly overridden by a hook.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::OnLookupComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a DNS lookup, logs results, and invokes callback.
